faq.domanda: Do you work with businesses in Locarno, Muralto and Ascona?
faq.risposta: Yes. We produce custom clothing in our workshop in Ticino, in Sementina, and we regularly serve restaurants, hotels, shops and associations throughout Locarno and the surrounding area, from Muralto to Minusio and out to Ascona. We can arrange delivery across the whole region or shipping, depending on your needs.

faq.domanda: Which is better for my business, DTF printing or embroidery?
faq.risposta: It depends on the use. DTF (Direct to Film) printing brings out colourful, detailed graphics beautifully on t-shirts and hoodies, ideal for event staff and promotional garments. Embroidery, more elegant and hard-wearing, enhances the polos, shirts and caps of hotels and restaurants, where a polished image matters. If you're unsure, we'll recommend the solution best suited to your fabric.

faq.domanda: Can you prepare staff uniforms in time for an event or the summer season?
faq.risposta: Yes, but it pays to move early. During peak periods, such as the weeks of the Film Festival or the start of the tourist season, demand grows. Get in touch a few weeks ahead and we'll schedule production so your garments are ready right on time.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to customise clothing in Locarno?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the technique chosen (DTF or embroidery), the complexity of the graphics and the number of garments. The higher the quantity, the more affordable each piece becomes. Send us your idea and we'll prepare a detailed, free quote in 24/48h.

faq.domanda: Can I order just one garment or a few t-shirts?
faq.risposta: Of course. We customise even a single garment, handy for a trial uniform, a gift or a private event. For larger quantities, typical of a venue's or hotel's staff, the unit price goes down.

We customise t-shirts, polos, hoodies, softshell jackets, shirts, aprons, caps and workwear. These are solutions designed for bars, restaurants, hotels, shops and sports teams, with the technique best suited to each fabric.

faq.domanda: Do the garments hold up to the frequent washing of the hospitality trade?
faq.risposta: Yes. Embroidery and DTF printing are made to last: in hospitality and catering, where garments are washed every day, they keep colours and details sharp for a long time, when washed according to the instructions provided.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to deliver an order?
faq.risposta: Timing depends on the quantity and the complexity of the graphics. Small orders usually take a few working days. For an entire venue's staff or for the tourist season, we'll give you a precise delivery date right at the quote stage.
